Definition: of uncertain derivation; Tertullus, a Roman:--Tertullus.
BiblicalUsage: Tertullus is the orator the chief priests hired to accuse Paul before Felix. In Acts 24:1, with a certain orator named Tertullus. The fuller story is told on the Tertullus profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Tertullus belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
